title: Para Bellum content: equipment classes
description: What a kind of equipment IS. File: Content/<namespace>/class.json. A class declares the stat surface its models may set, with a default for each stat, and the traits that are legal on it. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 3 in the game repository; when this schema and that document disagree, the document wins.

format.description: The file format and its version. A reader refuses a format it does not know rather than misread it.

id.description: A namespaced id, <namespace>:<name>, lower case. The namespace is the folder the file sits in: pb for shipped content, your mod's folder name for a mod. The player namespace is reserved for the save.

statKey.description: An engine stat key, with its unit in the name (_mm, _kph, _kg, _per_mille). Stat keys are fixed by the game's code and listed in Content/vocabulary.json. A content file cannot add one.

name.description: Display name. Optional: a missing or blank name displays the id.

stats.description: The stat surface: every stat a model or variant of this class may set, each with its default. A model that omits a stat takes this default. All values are whole numbers (integers), and none is negative.

traits.description: The traits that are legal on this class, by id. A model or variant carrying a trait not listed here is refused.
